div.div:
Safety first
Protection (GOOSE trips on the process bus) runs locally and never waits for the PEP. ZTC observes it and never gates it. In OT the order is safety → availability → integrity → confidentiality.

text.tspan: Protection (GOOSE trips on the process bus) runs
locally and never waits for the PEP. ZTC observes it and
never gates it. In OT the order is safety → availability →
